input.quote: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
input.rationale: Section 21.1 caps both Parties at one month of "Fees actually paid" and applies "without exception", which (i) sits far below the fallback 12-months'-fees basis and below the 6-month walk-away floor, and (ii) overrides the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2-21.3, so indemnities, confidentiality, data-protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement are all pulled inside a one-month cap with no super-cap. The defined "Fees" (§1.5) also excludes taxes, expenses and implementation charges, making the base narrower still. Section 21.2 already gives a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages, and 21.3 already lists the carve-outs and the payment carve-out, so the surgical fix is to correct the cap basis, restore the Excluded Claims exception, and broaden the payment noun from narrow "Fees" to "amounts due" while keeping the undisputed/conforming qualifiers.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
mappings.quote: 21.2 Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages, or for lost profits, revenues, or goodwill, to the extent those damages are legally excludable.

mappings.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.

proposal.summary: Make the mutual cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, restore the Excluded Claims carve-outs, and make the payment carve-out cover all amounts due.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] A one-month cap applying "without exception" is below our walk-away floor and cancels the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2-21.3, so we set the mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 and reinstated the Excluded Claims exception (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement stay uncapped). We also broadened the payment carve-out from narrowly defined "Fees" to amounts due, keeping the undisputed/conforming qualifiers.
